summary: Use cached API availability and priority-first bounded failover

delivery.outcome: Use first successful class-compatible API in declared priority order; share cached account failure cooldowns, avoid request-time availability sweeps and return one explicit exhausted-chain error.
nonGoals: No credentials, global provider policy, new API spending/model downloads, billing calls, class/format downgrade, unrelated primary patch or independent review changes.
No active availability sweeps on normal completion; preserve declared time/attempt bounds and opt-in helper compatibility.

architecture.decision: Reuse health.py provider state and policy_config execution thresholds in adaptive execution; keep compatible-class requirements, promote configured priority ahead of observed latency, and fail over on the actual request without speculative probe calls.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of adaptive execution only; existing shared health/SQLite layouts remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Reproduce sweep/priority defects before fix; demonstrate cached no-credit skip, different-model same-account skip, cross-process reuse/expiry, class and format boundaries, bounded all-exhausted error; native protected OneDev and independent exact-head review.
